sourceReviewSummary: The dates on this page follow the CCPS student-calendar PDF. We also reviewed the district's school-year calendar webpage on July 30, 2026. The two official sources list different Fall Break and Winter Break ranges, as explained above.
sourceReviewDetails: Each school year, MySchoolDates checks the dates shown on this page against the district's published calendar and other official calendar documents.
If official sources conflict, we document the difference and identify which version this page follows. We update the page when the district publishes a correction or revised calendar.

This page focuses on districtwide student dates. Staff-only dates outside the student school year are omitted from the student-date table. The downloadable calendar file is a one-time import generated from the calendar records used for this page.
Confirm program deadlines, transportation notices, and emergency schedule changes directly with CCPS.

calendarFaqs.q: Which dates should I follow when the CCPS calendars disagree?
calendarFaqs.a: This page follows the CCPS student-calendar PDF. The district webpage lists different Fall Break and Winter Break dates, so check the district calendar page for a correction before making plans.

calendarFaqs.q: What is the difference between Semester Break and Winter Break?
calendarFaqs.a: Semester Break is the late-December break from December 21 through January 1. Students return January 5 after a January 4 staff workday. Winter Break is listed separately in February, from February 16 through February 19.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the downloaded Clayton County calendar update automatically?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The downloaded MySchoolDates 2026–27 ICS file is a one-time import for Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, or Outlook. It will not update automatically if CCPS revises its calendar.

customSections.label: CCPS Sources List Different Break Dates
customSections.content: The CCPS student calendar shows Fall Break on October 12–16 and Winter Break on February 16–19. The district's calendar webpage lists October 13–16 and February 15–19 instead. The webpage also labels October 13 as a Monday, although it falls on a Tuesday in 2026. This page follows the student calendar while the two official sources remain inconsistent. The PDF also displays an adoption date of December 17, 2026, which is later than this page's July 30, 2026 review date. Check the district calendar page before booking travel or childcare.

customSections.label: ELBC Days, Staff Workdays, and Return Dates
customSections.content: Four dates are designated as ELBC days: August 24, September 8, November 3, and March 15. Students learn remotely on those days. January 4 is a PL Day / Workday, so students return from Semester Break on January 5.

items: CCPS labels the late-December break "Semester Break."
A separate Winter Break follows Presidents' Day in February.

customSections.label: Changes from the 2025–26 Calendar
customSections.content: Compared with 2025–26, school starts one day earlier and ends four days later. The number of ELBC days increases from three to four, and the new calendar lists a separate February Winter Break after Presidents' Day.
